Once farmers upstream were required to plant buffer strips of vegetation along riverbanks, water quality improved gradually, and by the early 2000s oyster populations had largely recovered.
exercises.question: It is stated in the passage that the algae harmed the oysters by ----.
options: reducing the amount of oxygen in the water as they decomposed
carrying fertiliser into the bay from upstream
blocking sunlight from reaching the seabed
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *algae* kelimesini tara → *as the algae decomposed, they consumed much of the oxygen* → 'reducing the amount of oxygen in the water'. 'carrying fertiliser into the bay' diyen şık metinde geçen bir bilgiyi yanlış özneye bağlar: gübreyi körfeze taşıyan yüzey akışıdır, alg değil.

exercises.passage: In the fictional coastal region of Ostrava Bay, oyster farming was once the main source of employment. During the 1980s, however, oyster harvests collapsed, and many farms closed. Local officials initially blamed overharvesting, introducing strict limits on the number of oysters that could be collected each year. Yet the harvests continued to decline. It was only when marine biologists examined the water itself that the real cause became apparent: run-off from newly expanded agricultural land upstream was carrying large amounts of fertiliser into the bay. The fertiliser caused algae to multiply rapidly, and as the algae decomposed, they consumed much of the oxygen in the water, leaving young oysters unable to survive. Once farmers upstream were required to plant buffer strips of vegetation along riverbanks, water quality improved gradually, and by the early 2000s oyster populations had largely recovered.
exercises.question: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage?
options: Overharvesting was the main reason for the collapse of the oyster industry.
The oyster industry in Ostrava Bay never recovered.
Buffer strips caused water quality to decline.
Marine biologists were responsible for expanding agriculture upstream.
Changes in land use far from the bay can affect marine life within it.
exercises.explanation: Yukarıdaki tarım alanlarının genişlemesi körfezdeki istiridyeleri öldürmüştür; buradan uzaktaki arazi kullanımının deniz yaşamını etkileyebileceği çıkarılır → 'Changes in land use far from the bay can affect marine life within it.' Kısayol: aşırı avlanmayı ana neden sayan, endüstrinin hiç toparlanmadığını söyleyen ve tampon şeritleri suçlayan şıklar metindeki bilgilerin tam tersidir ve hızla elenir.

exercises.question: The extent to which the new policy will reduce unemployment remains to be seen. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: The new policy has already reduced unemployment to a great extent.
Unemployment will remain high regardless of the new policy.
It has been shown that the new policy will not affect unemployment.
It is not yet known how much the new policy will reduce unemployment.
The new policy was introduced to measure unemployment more accurately.
exercises.explanation: *remains to be seen* = 'henüz belli değil' → 'It is not yet known how much the new policy will reduce unemployment.' Kısayol: kaynak cümle belirsizlik bildiriyor; kesin yargı içeren şıklar ('has already reduced', 'will remain high', 'has been shown') tek hamlede elenir.

exercises.passage: (I) Some species of fictional cave-dwelling fish in the Lurma caves have lost their eyesight over thousands of generations. (II) Caves are popular destinations for adventure tourists in many countries. (III) Instead of relying on sight, these fish detect movement through highly sensitive cells along their bodies. (IV) Researchers believe that maintaining eyes in total darkness offered no advantage and consumed valuable energy. (V) Over time, therefore, fish with smaller eyes may have been more likely to survive and reproduce.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: konuyu ilk cümleden çıkar (mağara balıklarının görme kaybı), sonra her cümlenin bu konuya hizmet edip etmediğine bak. II. cümle turizme geçer; *caves* kelimesi tanıdık geldiği için çeldiricidir. III. cümledeki *these fish* I. cümleye bağlanır.

exercises.passage: Many universities now record lectures and make them available online. Supporters argue that this helps students who miss classes due to illness or work. ---- A survey at a fictional university found that students with access to recordings attended 20 percent fewer lectures, and those who relied mainly on recordings tended to obtain lower final grades. Researchers suggest that recordings work best as a revision tool rather than as a replacement for attending class, and some lecturers now release recordings only after the week of the lecture has ended.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Critics, however, fear that recordings may encourage students to skip lectures.
Online lectures are cheaper to produce than textbooks.
Therefore, attendance at lectures has risen sharply.
Students who are ill should not attend lectures.
Most universities stopped recording lectures years ago.
exercises.explanation: Destekçilerin görüşünden sonra, devamsızlığın arttığını gösteren araştırmaya geçiliyor; arada karşı görüşü tanıtan 'Critics, however, fear …' gerekir. Kısayol: boşluktan sonraki cümlenin ilk bilgisi (*attended 20 percent fewer lectures*) cevabı doğrudan işaret eder; 'attendance … has risen' tam tersidir.

exercises.passage: Traditional accounts of the fictional Kerran Empire describe its final emperor as a weak ruler whose poor decisions led directly to the empire's fall. These accounts, however, were written mainly by court historians serving the dynasty that replaced him, and they had clear reasons to portray their predecessor negatively. More recent studies based on tax records and merchant letters paint a different picture. They indicate that the empire was already suffering from a long economic decline, caused by shifting trade routes, well before the last emperor came to power. While he may indeed have made serious mistakes, it seems unlikely that any ruler could have reversed the empire's decline at that stage.
exercises.question: The author suggests that the traditional accounts of the last emperor ----.
options: are completely reliable because they were written at court
were based on tax records and merchant letters
may be biased because of who wrote them
praise the emperor for his economic reforms
were written long after the empire's fall by foreign historians
exercises.explanation: Metin, geleneksel anlatıları yeni hanedana hizmet eden saray tarihçilerinin yazdığını ve selefi olumsuz göstermek için sebepleri olduğunu söyler → taraflı olabilirler: 'may be biased because of who wrote them'. 'were based on tax records and merchant letters' diyen şık yeni çalışmaların kaynaklarını eski anlatılara mal eder.

exercises.passage: Traditional accounts of the fictional Kerran Empire describe its final emperor as a weak ruler whose poor decisions led directly to the empire's fall. These accounts, however, were written mainly by court historians serving the dynasty that replaced him, and they had clear reasons to portray their predecessor negatively. More recent studies based on tax records and merchant letters paint a different picture. They indicate that the empire was already suffering from a long economic decline, caused by shifting trade routes, well before the last emperor came to power. While he may indeed have made serious mistakes, it seems unlikely that any ruler could have reversed the empire's decline at that stage.
exercises.question: According to the recent studies, the empire's decline ----.
options: began after the final emperor's first serious mistake
was caused mainly by a military invasion
was reversed briefly by the final emperor
had nothing to do with changes in trade
had started before the last emperor took the throne
exercises.explanation: *well before the last emperor came to power* → gerileme son imparatordan önce başlamıştı: 'had started before the last emperor took the throne'. Kısayol: kökteki *recent studies* ifadesini tara, tek cümlede cevap var. 'had nothing to do with changes in trade' diyen şık metne zıttır; gerilemenin nedeni ticaret yollarının değişmesidir.

exercises.passage: Traditional accounts of the fictional Kerran Empire describe its final emperor as a weak ruler whose poor decisions led directly to the empire's fall. These accounts, however, were written mainly by court historians serving the dynasty that replaced him, and they had clear reasons to portray their predecessor negatively. More recent studies based on tax records and merchant letters paint a different picture. They indicate that the empire was already suffering from a long economic decline, caused by shifting trade routes, well before the last emperor came to power. While he may indeed have made serious mistakes, it seems unlikely that any ruler could have reversed the empire's decline at that stage.
exercises.question: The main purpose of the passage is to ----.
options: describe the daily life of merchants in the Kerran Empire
argue that the final emperor was an excellent ruler
explain how tax records were collected in the empire
challenge a traditional explanation for the fall of the empire
compare the Kerran Empire with the dynasty that replaced it
exercises.explanation: Metin geleneksel açıklamayı verir, sonra yeni kanıtlarla onu sorgular → 'challenge a traditional explanation for the fall of the empire'. 'the final emperor was an excellent ruler' diyen şık aşırıya kaçar: yazar imparatorun ciddi hatalar yapmış olabileceğini kabul eder. Ana fikir sorularında metnin ilk ve son cümlelerini okumak çoğu zaman yeterlidir.

exercises.passage:
Student: I keep running out of time in the reading section.
Teacher: Do you read the whole passage before looking at the questions?
Student: Yes, usually twice, to make sure I understand everything.
Teacher: ----
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: That's right; reading the passage three times would be even better.
Try reading the question first, then scan the passage for the relevant part.
The reading section always has the easiest questions.
You should spend more time on the vocabulary questions.
I didn't know there was a reading section in the exam.
exercises.explanation: Öğrencinin sorunu süre; metni iki kez okumak bunun sebebi. Öğretmenin mantıklı önerisi önce soruyu okuyup metni taramaktır → 'Try reading the question first, then scan the passage …'. 'reading the passage three times' diyen şık sorunu daha da büyütür; kelime sorularına daha çok zaman ayırmayı öneren şık okuma sorununa çözüm getirmez.

exercises.question: Sınavda kalan 10 dakikada henüz çözülmemiş 6 paragraf sorusu (iki ayrı metin) var ve cevapların hepsi optik forma aktarılmış durumda. En mantıklı hamle hangisidir?
options: Birinci metni dikkatle baştan sona okuyup yalnızca onun sorularını çözmek, kalanları boş bırakmak
Hiçbir soruyu işaretlememek, çünkü acele edince hata yapılır
Önceki bölümlerdeki emin olunan soruları tekrar kontrol etmek
Tüm soruları rastgele aynı harfle işaretleyip sınavdan çıkmak
Önce soru köklerini okuyup metinde ilgili yeri tarayarak soruları çözmek, son dakikada kalan boş soruları tahminle işaretlemek
exercises.explanation: 10 dakikada 6 soru için en verimli yol soru kökünden metne gitmek ve süre biterken boşları tahminle doldurmaktır → 'önce soru köklerini okuyup metinde ilgili yeri tarayarak … kalan boş soruları tahminle işaretlemek'. 'Birinci metni dikkatle baştan sona okuyup' diyen şık üç soruyu boş bırakır; YDS'de yanlış doğruyu götürmediği için boş bırakmak kesin puan kaybıdır. Rastgele işaretleme ise çözülebilecek soruları da harcar.

exercises.question: The committee's report was ---- criticised for ignoring evidence that contradicted its main conclusions.
exercises.explanation: Kanıtları görmezden gelen bir rapor 'widely' (yaygın olarak) eleştirilir. 'Barely' (neredeyse hiç) eleştirinin gerekçesiyle çelişir; 'accidentally' (kazara) eleştiri için anlamsızdır. Hedef süre: 30 saniye.

exercises.question: By the end of this decade, scientists ---- the genomes of most known plant species.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *By the end of + gelecek zaman ifadesi* → future perfect: 'will have sequenced'. 'Had sequenced' *by the end of last decade* gibi geçmiş bir sınır gerektirir; diğer şıklar zaman ifadesiyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: The vaccine is highly effective; ----, it must be stored at extremely low temperatures, which makes distribution difficult in remote areas.
exercises.explanation: Olumlu bilgi (çok etkili) ile olumsuz bilgi (dağıtımı zor) arasında zıtlık → 'however'. Kısayol: noktalı virgülün iki yanındaki cümlelerin yönü farklıysa yalnızca zıtlık bağlaçlarına bak; 'thus' sonuç bildirir.

exercises.question: The ancient city was so well hidden by dense forest ----.
options: that it remained unknown to outsiders until the twentieth century
because it was located near the coast
so that tourists could visit it more often
although archaeologists have studied it for years
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *so + sıfat/zarf* gördüğün an *that* ile başlayan sonuç cümlesini ara → 'that it remained unknown …'. 'So that' amaç bildirir ve *so well hidden* yapısını tamamlamaz; diğer şıklar kalıba uymaz.

exercises.question: Researchers have warned that, if current trends continue, antibiotic-resistant infections could become a leading cause of death within the next few decades.
options: Araştırmacılar, antibiyotiğe dirençli enfeksiyonların son on yıllarda önde gelen ölüm nedenlerinden biri olduğunu açıklamıştır.
Araştırmacılara göre mevcut eğilimler sürmezse antibiyotiğe dirençli enfeksiyonlar önümüzdeki on yıllarda azalacaktır.
Araştırmacılar, mevcut eğilimler sürerse antibiyotiğe dirençli enfeksiyonların önümüzdeki birkaç on yıl içinde önde gelen ölüm nedenlerinden biri hâline gelebileceği konusunda uyarmıştır.
Araştırmacılar, antibiyotiğe dirençli enfeksiyonların önümüzdeki birkaç on yıl içinde kesinlikle önde gelen ölüm nedeni olacağını kanıtlamıştır.
Mevcut eğilimler, araştırmacıların antibiyotiklere karşı direnç geliştirmesine neden olmaktadır.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: üç kontrol yap: zaman (*within the next few decades* = önümüzdeki), kesinlik (*could* = -ebilir) ve fiil (*warned* = uyarmıştır). Üçünü birden karşılayan tek şık 'mevcut eğilimler sürerse … hâline gelebileceği konusunda uyarmıştır' diyendir. 'Son on yıllarda' diyen şık zamanı geçmişe çevirir; 'kesinlikle … olacağını kanıtlamıştır' diyen şık *could*'u 'kesinlikle' yapar.

exercises.question: Not until the late afternoon ---- that the main road had been blocked by a landslide.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: cümle *Not until* ile başlıyorsa ana cümle devriktir: *did + özne + V1* → 'did the drivers realise'. Düz sıralı şıklar ('the drivers realised') ve yardımcı fiilsiz devrikler ('realised the drivers') tek bakışta elenir.

exercises.passage: A fictional study of 400 commuters found that those who cycled to work reported lower stress levels than those who drove, even when their journeys took longer. The researchers suggest that cycling offers a sense of control and predictability that drivers, who frequently face unexpected traffic jams, often lack. They also note that regular physical activity is known to improve mood. However, the authors caution that cyclists in the study tended to live closer to their workplaces, which may partly explain the difference.
exercises.question: Which of the following is a limitation of the study mentioned in the passage?
options: Cyclists' journeys always took less time than drivers' journeys.
Cyclists tended to live nearer to work, which might affect the results.
The study did not include any drivers.
Physical activity has no effect on mood.
Drivers reported lower stress than cyclists.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *limitation* soruları çoğunlukla *however, caution, may partly explain* gibi ifadelerin olduğu son cümlelerde cevaplanır → 'Cyclists tended to live nearer to work, which might affect the results.' 'Cyclists' journeys always took less time' diyen şık metne zıttır (*even when their journeys took longer*); 'Drivers reported lower stress' diyen şık bulguyu tersine çevirir.

exercises.passage: (I) Translation software has improved dramatically in recent years thanks to advances in machine learning. (II) Modern systems can now produce fluent translations of everyday texts within seconds. (III) Nevertheless, they still struggle with idioms, humour and texts that depend heavily on cultural context. (IV) Learning to play a musical instrument also requires years of regular practice. (V) For this reason, professional translators remain essential for legal, literary and medical documents.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf çeviri yazılımlarının gücünü ve sınırlarını anlatır; IV. cümle müzik aleti öğrenmeye geçer. Kısayol: V. cümledeki *For this reason* doğrudan III. cümleye bağlanmalıdır; araya giren IV. cümle bu bağı koparır.

exercises.question: Only after the results had been checked by an independent laboratory were they made public. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: The results were not made public until an independent laboratory had checked them.
An independent laboratory published the results before checking them.
The results were made public, and then an independent laboratory checked them.
The independent laboratory refused to check the results that had been made public.
Only the independent laboratory was allowed to see the results.
exercises.explanation: *Only after X … Y* = 'X'ten sonra ancak Y' = *not … until X* → 'The results were not made public until an independent laboratory had checked them.' Kısayol: önce olayların sırasını belirle (önce kontrol, sonra açıklama); sırayı tersine çeviren 'published the results before checking them' ve 'made public, and then … checked them' şıkları hemen elenir.

exercises.question: Kentsel alanlarda ağaç sayısının artırılması, yaz aylarında sıcaklıkların birkaç derece düşmesine katkıda bulunabilir.
options: Temperatures in urban areas have fallen by several degrees because the number of trees has increased.
Increasing temperatures in summer have reduced the number of trees in urban areas.
Increasing the number of trees in urban areas can help reduce temperatures by several degrees in the summer months.
Trees in urban areas can only survive if temperatures fall by several degrees in summer.
The number of trees in urban areas should be increased in the summer months to reduce costs.
exercises.explanation: 'Artırılması' = *Increasing*, 'katkıda bulunabilir' = *can help* → 'Increasing the number of trees … can help reduce temperatures'. Kısayol: kaynakta 'olasılık' (-abilir) var; kesin geçmiş bir sonuç bildiren 'Temperatures … have fallen' şıkkı bu yüzden elenir. 'Increasing temperatures … have reduced the number of trees' diyen şık neden-sonucu tersine çevirir.

exercises.question: Sınavın 150. dakikasındasın; optik forma henüz hiçbir cevap aktarmadın ve 12 soru çözülmemiş. En doğru hamle hangisidir?
options: Hemen cevapları optik forma aktarmaya başlamak, ardından kalan sürede çözülmemiş soruları çözmek
Önce 12 soruyu çözmek, cevapları son 2 dakikada aktarmak
Optik formu boş teslim edip kitapçıktaki işaretlerin değerlendirilmesini istemek
Çözülmemiş soruların hepsini atlayıp çözülmüş soruları yeniden kontrol etmek
Cevapları aktarmayı bırakıp yalnızca kolay soruları çözmek
exercises.explanation: Değerlendirilen yalnızca optik formdur; 68 cevabı aktarmak 10 dakikayı bulabilir, bu yüzden önce güvenceye almak gerekir → 'hemen cevapları optik forma aktarmaya başlamak'. 'Son 2 dakikada aktarmak' kaydırma hatası ve yetişememe riski taşır; kitapçıktaki işaretler puanlanmaz.

exercises.question: The scholarship is ---- only to students whose families earn below a certain income.
exercises.explanation: Burs belirli öğrencilere 'available' (açık, erişilebilir) olur; *available to* doğal bir kalıptır. 'Eager' ve 'reluctant' (istekli, isteksiz) insanlar için kullanılır, bursa uymaz. Hedef süre: 30 saniye.

exercises.question: Officials have been accused of trying to ---- the true extent of the pollution by publishing incomplete data.
exercises.explanation: Eksik veri yayımlayarak kirliliğin gerçek boyutu 'conceal' edilir (gizlenir); *accused of* de olumsuz bir eylem bekler. 'Reveal' (ortaya çıkarmak) tam tersidir; 'reduce' kirliliği azaltır ama eksik veri yayımlamak bunu sağlamaz.

exercises.question: By the time the new hospital opens next year, the old one ---- for over a century.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *By the time + geniş zaman (gelecek anlamlı)* + *next year* → future perfect: 'will have served'. 'Had served' geçmişteki bir sınır gerektirir; diğer şıklar zaman ifadesiyle uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: The candidates, most of ---- had taken the exam before, finished well within the time limit.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *most of / some of / all of* gibi niceleyicilerden sonra insanlar için 'whom' gelir → 'most of whom'. 'Who' edattan sonra kullanılmaz; 'them' iki cümleyi bağlayamaz ve virgüllü yapıyı bozar.

exercises.passage: In a fictional experiment at Delvin University, 120 students sat two practice exams of equal difficulty. In the first, they could spend as long as they liked on each question; (1) ----, in the second, they were told to move on after two minutes and return to difficult questions only at the end. Surprisingly, scores were higher in the second exam, (2) ---- students had less time for the hardest items. The researchers believe that leaving difficult questions until later prevents candidates (3) ---- valuable time that could be spent on easier ones.
exercises.question: Parçadaki (1) numaralı boşluğa gelebilecek en uygun ifade hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: İki sınavın kuralları karşılaştırılıyor: ilkinde süre sınırsız, ikincisinde iki dakika → 'by contrast' (buna karşılık). 'Similarly' benzerlik bildirir ve karşıtlığı yok eder; 'therefore' ile 'as a result' aynı anlamda olduğu için ikisi birlikte elenir.

exercises.passage: In a fictional experiment at Delvin University, 120 students sat two practice exams of equal difficulty. In the first, they could spend as long as they liked on each question; (1) ----, in the second, they were told to move on after two minutes and return to difficult questions only at the end. Surprisingly, scores were higher in the second exam, (2) ---- students had less time for the hardest items. The researchers believe that leaving difficult questions until later prevents candidates (3) ---- valuable time that could be spent on easier ones.
exercises.question: Parçadaki (2) numaralı boşluğa gelebilecek en uygun ifade hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: *Surprisingly* beklenmedik bir sonucu haber verir: en zor sorulara daha az zaman olmasına rağmen puanlar yüksek → 'even though'. 'Because' daha az zamanı yüksek puanın sebebi yapar ve *Surprisingly* ile çelişir.

exercises.passage: In a fictional experiment at Delvin University, 120 students sat two practice exams of equal difficulty. In the first, they could spend as long as they liked on each question; (1) ----, in the second, they were told to move on after two minutes and return to difficult questions only at the end. Surprisingly, scores were higher in the second exam, (2) ---- students had less time for the hardest items. The researchers believe that leaving difficult questions until later prevents candidates (3) ---- valuable time that could be spent on easier ones.
exercises.question: Parçadaki (3) numaralı boşluğa gelebilecek en uygun ifade hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *prevent somebody from doing something* kalıbı → 'from wasting'. Kalıbı bilen aday şıkları okumadan cevabı bulur; 'to waste' Türkçedeki '-mesini engellemek' düşüncesiyle seçilen yaygın bir hatadır.

exercises.question: If candidates spend too long on the vocabulary section, ----.
options: they may not have enough time for the reading passages
they would have finished the exam earlier
they had answered every question correctly
the reading passages were much shorter
they have scored higher last year
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *If + geniş zaman* → ana cümlede *will/may/can*. 'Would have finished', 'had answered', 'were' ve 'have scored … last year' zaman uyumundan hemen elenir; cevap 'they may not have enough time for the reading passages'.

exercises.question: ----, she managed to answer all eighty questions within the time limit.
options: Because she had never taken a timed practice test
Unless she reads the questions first
So that the exam would be easier
Since the reading passages were extremely long
Although she spent nearly half an hour on the first passage
exercises.explanation: *managed to* (başarabildi) bir zorluğa rağmen başarıyı ima eder → zıtlık: 'Although she spent nearly half an hour on the first passage'. 'Since the reading passages were extremely long' uzun metinleri başarının sebebi yapar, mantıksızdır; 'Unless she reads' zaman uyumuna uymaz.

exercises.question: The exam was so long that ----.
options: it consisted of only twenty questions
candidates finished it in less than an hour
many candidates could not finish it in the time allowed
it is easier than last year's exam
which surprised most of the candidates
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: *so … that* kalıbı sonuç ister ve sonuç 'uzunluğa' uygun olmalı → 'many candidates could not finish it in the time allowed'. 'Only twenty questions' ve 'less than an hour' uzunlukla çelişir; 'which …' *that*'tan sonra yapıyı bozar.

exercises.question: Candidates who skip difficult questions and return to them later tend to score higher than those who try to answer every question in order.
options: Zor soruları atlayan adaylar, soruları sırayla cevaplayanlara göre daha düşük puan alır.
Zor soruları atlayıp onlara daha sonra dönen adaylar, her soruyu sırayla cevaplamaya çalışanlardan daha yüksek puan alma eğilimindedir.
Her soruyu sırayla cevaplayan adaylar, zor sorulara daha sonra dönmek zorunda kalır.
Zor sorulara daha sonra dönmek, adayların her soruyu cevaplamasını kesinlikle sağlar.
Adayların çoğu, zor soruları atlayıp sınavın sonunda cevaplamayı tercih etmektedir.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: kaynaktaki karşılaştırmayı (*score higher than*) ve kesinlik derecesini (*tend to* = eğilimindedir) kontrol et → 'zor soruları atlayıp onlara daha sonra dönen adaylar … daha yüksek puan alma eğilimindedir'. 'Daha düşük puan alır' diyen şık karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir; 'kesinlikle sağlar' diyen şıktaki 'kesinlikle' kaynakta yoktur.

exercises.question: Sınavda zamanını iyi yöneten adaylar, okuma sorularına daha fazla süre ayırabilir.
options: Candidates who manage their time well in the exam can allocate more time to the reading questions.
Candidates who spend more time on reading questions manage their time poorly.
Reading questions take less time for candidates who manage their time well.
Time management is not as important as reading skills in the exam.
Candidates must answer the reading questions first in order to manage their time well.
exercises.explanation: 'Zamanını iyi yöneten adaylar' = *Candidates who manage their time well*, 'daha fazla süre ayırabilir' = *can allocate more time* → 'Candidates who manage their time well … can allocate more time to the reading questions.' *must … first* diyen şık zorunluluk ve sıralama ekler; 'Reading questions take less time' diyen şık 'daha az süre alır' diyerek anlamı değiştirir.

exercises.passage: Many candidates believe that checking their answers at the end of an exam always improves their score. A fictional study of 500 test-takers suggests that the picture is more complicated. Researchers found that when candidates changed an answer during the final review, the new answer was correct more often than not, but only if the change was based on a specific reason, such as noticing a missed word. Changes made simply because a candidate felt uneasy about the original answer were far less likely to be correct. The researchers therefore recommend that candidates revise answers only when they can identify a clear error.
exercises.question: According to the passage, changing an answer during the final review was most likely to be helpful when ----.
options: the candidate felt uneasy about the original answer
the candidate had plenty of time left
the question was in the reading section
the change was based on a concrete reason such as a missed word
the candidate changed several answers at once
exercises.explanation: Metin: yeni cevap ancak değişiklik belirli bir sebebe (ör. atlanan bir kelime) dayandığında çoğunlukla doğruydu → 'the change was based on a concrete reason such as a missed word'. 'the candidate felt uneasy' diyen şık metinde geçen *uneasy* kelimesini kullanır ama tam tersi bir durumu anlatır.

exercises.passage: Many candidates believe that checking their answers at the end of an exam always improves their score. A fictional study of 500 test-takers suggests that the picture is more complicated. Researchers found that when candidates changed an answer during the final review, the new answer was correct more often than not, but only if the change was based on a specific reason, such as noticing a missed word. Changes made simply because a candidate felt uneasy about the original answer were far less likely to be correct. The researchers therefore recommend that candidates revise answers only when they can identify a clear error.
exercises.question: The researchers' recommendation suggests that candidates should ----.
options: never change their answers during the final review
always change answers they feel uneasy about
skip the final review to save time
change answers only in the vocabulary section
avoid revising an answer unless they can find a specific mistake
exercises.explanation: *revise answers only when they can identify a clear error* = belirli bir hata bulmadıkça cevabı değiştirme → 'avoid revising an answer unless they can find a specific mistake'. *never change* diyen şık aşırı genellemedir; 'always change answers they feel uneasy about' diyen şık araştırmanın uyarısının tam tersidir.

exercises.passage: Optical answer sheets are read by machines that detect dark marks in each answer box. A fictional analysis of rejected sheets at a testing centre found that most scoring problems were not caused by wrong answers but by marking errors. The most common error was shifting: a candidate who skipped a question in the booklet but forgot to skip the corresponding line on the sheet would place every subsequent answer one row too high. Light or incomplete marks were the second most common problem. The analysis concluded that candidates who transferred their answers in small groups, for example after every page, made far fewer shifting errors than those who transferred all their answers at the very end.
exercises.question: According to the analysis, a 'shifting' error occurs when ----.
options: a candidate makes the marks too light
the machine fails to read the answer sheet
a skipped question causes later answers to be marked on the wrong line
a candidate changes too many answers
the answer sheet is submitted late
exercises.explanation: Kaydırma hatası: kitapçıkta atlanan soru formda atlanmayınca sonraki tüm cevaplar bir satır kayar → 'a skipped question causes later answers to be marked on the wrong line'. 'makes the marks too light' diyen şık metindeki ikinci sorunu (silik işaretler) anlatır; kaydırmayla karıştırılması için konmuş 'kısmen doğru' bir çeldiricidir.

exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that candidates can reduce marking errors by ----.
options: transferring all their answers only at the very end
transferring their answers to the sheet regularly during the exam
skipping difficult questions in the booklet
using lighter marks on the answer sheet
exercises.explanation: Cevaplarını küçük gruplar hâlinde (ör. her sayfadan sonra) aktaranlar çok daha az hata yapmış → düzenli aktarmak hatayı azaltır: 'transferring their answers to the sheet regularly during the exam'. 'only at the very end' diyen şık metnin tam tersidir; 'using lighter marks' diyen şık ikinci yaygın sorunu (silik işaret) önerir.

exercises.passage:
Candidate: I've finished the grammar section, and I still have 140 minutes left.
Tutor: That's a good pace. How many questions are left?
Candidate: Sixty-four, including all the reading passages.
Tutor: ----
exercises.question: Diyalogda boş bırakılan yere gelebilecek en uygun ifadeyi seçiniz.
options: Then you have a little over two minutes per question, so keep that rhythm and don't get stuck on a single passage.
That means you have less than one minute for each question.
You'd better go back and check every grammar question twice.
Reading passages are usually the easiest part of the exam.
Then you should leave the reading passages blank.
exercises.explanation: 140 dakika / 64 soru ≈ 2,2 dakika → 'a little over two minutes per question' doğru hesap ve mantıklı tavsiyedir. 'less than one minute for each question' diyen şık hesabı yanlış yapar; 'leave the reading passages blank' diyen şık okuma sorularını boş bırakmayı önerir, bu da kesin puan kaybıdır.

exercises.question: Candidates are not allowed to leave the exam hall until at least one hour has passed. (Anlamca en yakın cümleyi seçiniz.)
options: Candidates must leave the exam hall after one hour.
Candidates may leave the hall whenever they finish.
The exam lasts only one hour.
Candidates who arrive more than an hour late cannot enter the hall.
Candidates can leave the exam hall only after the first hour of the exam.
exercises.explanation: *not allowed … until at least one hour has passed* = 'ilk bir saat dolmadan çıkamazlar' = 'ancak ilk saatten sonra çıkabilirler' → 'can leave the exam hall only after the first hour'. *must leave* diyen şık izni zorunluluğa çevirir; 'may leave the hall whenever they finish' diyen şık kısıtlamayı tamamen kaldırır.

exercises.passage: Time pressure affects candidates in different ways, and recognising one’s own pattern is the first step towards managing it. ---- Others, however, become so anxious about the clock that they rush through questions and make careless mistakes. Experts suggest that regular practice under timed conditions can help candidates of both types find a steady and realistic pace. Recording how long each section takes during practice tests also makes it easier to see where minutes are being lost and to set realistic targets for the real exam.
exercises.question: Parçada boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek cümleyi seçiniz.
options: Exams are usually held on weekends.
Therefore, timed practice should be avoided.
The clock in the exam hall is often hard to see.
Some spend too long on early questions and run out of time at the end.
Most candidates finish the exam early.
exercises.explanation: Kısayol: boşluktan sonraki *Others, however* bir *Some* cümlesi bekler ve son cümle *both types* der → 'Some spend too long on early questions …'. 'The clock … is often hard to see' *clock* kelimesini tekrarlayan bir çeldiricidir; 'timed practice should be avoided' son cümleyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: (I) A good final fifteen minutes can make a noticeable difference to an exam score. (II) Candidates should first make sure that every answer has been transferred correctly to the answer sheet. (III) Many universities require a language certificate for admission to postgraduate programmes. (IV) Next, any unanswered questions should be marked, since there is no penalty for wrong answers. (V) Only then is it worth using the remaining minutes to reconsider uncertain items.
exercises.question: Parçada anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
exercises.explanation: Paragraf son 15 dakikanın sırayla nasıl kullanılacağını anlatır (*first, next, only then*); III. cümle lisansüstü kabul şartlarına geçer ve bu sıralamayı böler. Kısayol: sıralama bildiren kelimeleri (*first, next*) takip edince araya giren cümle hemen görünür.
